start: ^We have done three of these already this month. It is heavy work hammering spikes through bone, but you get used to the rhythm.
^But this one... when the sky went pitch black at noon, the entire detail stopped gambling for the garments.
^Even the Centurion looks like he has seen a ghost. This is not a standard provincial execution.

s: ^What did he say right before the end?
^Is the guard detail staying on the hill tonight?

phrase: ^He did not curse us like the others. He said, 'Father, forgive them.' It felt like the ground was moving beneath our boots.
guard: ^We are posted here until the bodies are broken and taken down. No one wants to sit in this darkness, but orders are orders.
